text:
incident-bot: Paging on-call — high rate of 429s from Stripe /events webhook ingestion observed at 2026-03-15T14:40:56Z. Auto-alerting thresholds tripped (5xx/429 > 15m).
Sara L: seeing a spike in webhook failures, lots of retries queued in our ingestion service.
Omar R: confirmed 429s with body: "{\"error\":{\"type\":\"rate_limit\",\"message\":\"Too many requests\"}}" — appears to be rate-limiting on invoices/events endpoint.
Amanda C: impact? Are customers losing access or just delayed billing events?
Jia W: initial triage — webhooks are failing to deliver entitlement-change events. Some customers' paid features are being enforced as 'unpaid' after TTL expiry.
Mike P: we have ~12 customers in grace-window failing entitlement refresh; list: acct_redwood_114, acct_redwood_421, acct_redwood_732 (partial list).
Elaine S: creating internal incident page and flagging P2 until we confirm user-visible outages.
oncall-rotations-bot: @Sara L is on-call for incidents for the next 45 minutes.
Sara L: handoff noted — Omar, can you try switching ingestion to our secondary webhook endpoint that staggers deliveries across different Stripe region? (runbook step 2)
Omar R: attempting now — updating ingress rule to route stripe events -> stripe-ingest-fallback (will keep primary warm). ETA ~6m.
incident-bot: Deploy started: stripe-ingest-routing v1.4.2 by Omar R — tracking in #eng-releases
Amanda C: in parallel, can we enable local entitlement cache for 2 hours to let existing sessions stay active until events resume?
Jia W: yes. Patching gatekeeper config: {
  "entitlement_ttl_extension": "7200s",
  "source": "manual-incident"
}
Mike P: applied cache extension on prod in 1 region; rolling to others. monitoring for inconsistent state.
Sara L: reached out to Stripe support via dashboard, created case CS-998273. They replied: "We're investigating a surge causing API throttling for some customers in EU region." They asked for a delivery_id sample.
Omar R: pasted sample delivery id: evt_3KOZ... and logs showing 429 with x-request-id. cURL we sent:
``
curl -i -X POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/events -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***" -d '{"id":"evt_3KOZ..."}'
```
stripe-ops-bot: auto-update: Stripe case CS-998273 status -> 'Investigating' (2026-03-15T14:51:00Z)
Amanda C: customer-facing messaging? Ops/Support — prepare a brief note for affected tenants: "We are experiencing delays in processing billing events due to upstream Stripe throttling; access to paid features may be delayed for up to 2 hours. We're mitigating via polling fallback and cache extension." Keep it short.
Elaine S: drafting status page update now. Will post at least once every 30m until resolved.
Mike P: mitigation summary: (1) route to fallback endpoint, (2) enable TTL extension, (3) enable limited polling for missed events every 30s for critical customers, (4) open support case with Stripe and request quota increase or mitigation.
Jia W: implemented limited polling worker — hits Stripe API for missing invoices for the 12 affected customers. Rate-limited aggressively to avoid worsening the problem: concurrency 2, jittered backoff.
Omar R: fallback routing live in prod EU-1 and EU-2. Observability shows webhook success rate rising from 68%->92% in EU-2. Still seeing occasional 429 bursts.
Sara L: SLA / billing implications — finance/product: if Stripe enforces quota and delays billing, customers may be able to keep product access longer, but revenue recognition is delayed. We need to track counts.
Amanda C: started a spreadsheet tracker: column: customer, acct_id, impacted_since, mitigation_status, followup_required.
Elaine S: support already notified top 5 impacted customers with workaround note. No escalations yet but 2 support tickets opened.
Sara L: on-call handoff in 40m to Mike P. I'll summarize current state: fallback routing live, cache TTL extended, polling worker running, Stripe investigating (CS-998273), status page updated, 12 customers affected, partial recovery observed.
oncall-rotations-bot: handover reminder set for 2026-03-15T15:20:56Z.
Mike P: thanks — I'll take over monitoring. If Stripe indicates sustained quota enforcement we should enable broader polling and consider temporary leniency flag for entitlements to avoid mass churn.
Amanda C: legal/compliance note — document decisions for audit: if we change entitlement enforcement policy temporarily, we must record who authorized it.
Sara L: agreed. tagging @Elaine S and @Amanda C to record approval.
stripe-ops-bot: Stripe case CS-998273 update -> 'Mitigation in progress; increased regional throughput for our account' (2026-03-15T15:05:10Z)
Jia W: observing fewer 429s for polled endpoints. Polling worker retrieved 9/12 missing events and applied them; remaining 3 pending.
Mike P: I'll escalate to on-call pager if >30m with no progress on remaining 3.
Elaine S: final note — capture timeline in postmortem template, include runbook adherence (third-party outage section), CS case ID, list of affected customers, and decision log.
Sara L: thanks team. I'll keep incident open and update again on handoff.
